cityStatistic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Mexico City? Hotel Prices for Mexico City, Mexico | Budget Your Trip
cityStatistic.evidenceText: With data for 11 great hotels, the average price for 1-star hotels in Mexico City is $51, and the median price is $50.
cityStatistic.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip hotel-price analysis; result crawled last month (July 2026); 1-star sample of 11 hotels
cityStatistic.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Mexico City Mexico 1 star hotel average price
cityStatistic.reason: The exact-city BudgetYourTrip hotel analysis identifies the 1-star class, gives a non-from city average in USD, and exposes an 11-hotel sample. Occupancy remains unknown_source_default; this is calibration evidence only and is not an observed two-adult product anchor.

explicitQuotesReason: The Booking.com search returned exact Mexico City properties with two-adult room prices, but none was explicitly identified as a 1-star property. The Hotels.com search returned one-star-filter and 2-star listings, but no named property simultaneously had an explicit 1-star class, two-adult/one-room basis, and qualifying non-from nightly price. No generic hotel or class-ambiguous quote was retained, and no value was mapped to the city statistic.
